# runInTerminal in an untrusted workspace is refused; the adapter then
# fails the launch.
> initialize
< {"body": {}}
> launch
< reverse runInTerminal {"kind": "integrated", "cwd": "/w", "args": ["/w/app"]}
> response runInTerminal {"success": false, "message": "runInTerminal needs a trusted workspace"}
< {"type": "response", "request_seq": 2, "command": "launch", "success": false, "message": "runInTerminal refused"}
< event initialized
